result.explanation: Maintains residents in FIFO order, storing each key’s value, pin count, and tombstone state. Live puts replace values in place; new puts evict the oldest unpinned resident when capacity is full. Pinned invalidations create tombstones, which remain until their final unpin. Outputs are derived after every event.
result.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let a=Array.isArray(state)?state:[],k=event.key,t=event.type,i=a.findIndex(x=>x.key===k),status="ignored",value=null;if(t==="put"){if(i>=0){if(a[i].tomb)status="blocked";else{a[i].value=event.value;status="stored"}}else if(a.length<config.capacity){a.push({key:k,value:event.value,pins:0,tomb:false});status="stored"}else{let j=a.findIndex(x=>x.pins===0);if(j<0)status="blocked";else{a.splice(j,1);a.push({key:k,value:event.value,pins:0,tomb:false});status="stored"}}}else if(t==="pin"){if(i<0)status="missing";else if(a[i].tomb)status="ignored";else{a[i].pins++;status="pinned"}}else if(t==="unpin"){if(i<0||a[i].pins===0)status="ignored";else{a[i].pins--;status="released";if(a[i].tomb&&!a[i].pins)a.splice(i,1)}}else if(t==="invalidate"){if(i<0)status="missing";else if(a[i].tomb)status="ignored";else if(a[i].pins){a[i].tomb=true;status="invalidated"}else{a.splice(i,1);status="invalidated"}}else if(t==="get"){if(i>=0&&!a[i].tomb){value=a[i].value;status="hit"}else status="miss"}let order=[],pins={},tombstones=[];for(let x of a){order.push(x.key);pins[x.key]=x.pins;if(x.tomb)tombstones.push(x.key)}tombstones.sort();return{state:a,output:{status:status,value:value,order:order,pins:pins,tombstones:tombstones}}}
